entities.title: UTV 1.0 values (utv/1.0)
entities.summary: The serialized form of a temporal value: one envelope, {"schema": "utv/1.0", "kind": …, "value": …}, with 26 core kinds.
consumers: Every UTV library under implementations/, which reads and writes these values
Any outside reader or writer of UTV values
guarantees: schema and kind are mandatory; schema is the wire identifier utv/<major>.<minor>, and nested values carry the same identifier as their envelope.
Readers fail closed: unknown kinds, unknown core properties, unknown critical extensions and duplicate JSON keys are rejected.
A well-formed identifier newer than the reader implements is unsupported, not invalid.
Arbitrary-precision integers are canonical decimal strings; fractions are exact rationals reduced to lowest terms; null is never a placeholder for an unknown.
The specification governs meaning; the JSON Schema governs only serialized field names and shapes.
entities.compatibility: VERSIONING.md: adding a kind, an optional property or an enum value is a minor version (utv/1.1); renaming or removing one, or changing what a value means, is a major version (utv/2.0); editorial fixes are a patch and leave the wire identifier alone. A reader implementing 1.N accepts utv/1.M for every M ≤ N.

entities.title: Evaluation results (utv-result/1.0)
entities.summary: The envelope every semantic operation returns: operation, status, candidates, cardinality, manifest, assumptions, loss and diagnostics.
consumers: Every UTV library under implementations/, whose results mirror this envelope
guarantees: status is one of invalid, unsupported, indeterminate, none, unique, multiple, range, symbolic, resource-limit, error, or valid for validation.
none, multiple, indeterminate, unsupported and resource-limit are successful, truthful outcomes; none is allowed only after a complete proof within the declared domain.
Operations are pure functions of explicit context and immutable registries: no fetching, shelling out or hidden system time.
compare returns a set of possible relations, never a forced boolean.
entities.compatibility: Versioned in lockstep with the specification (VERSIONING.md, Wire identifiers).
